en.title: Rome I: which Member State prevails when two Member States impose conflicting compulsory insurance on the same risk?
en.summary: Point (a) of Article 7(4) gives priority to the law of the Member State imposing the obligation to take out insurance, and point (b) lets each such State require the contract to be governed by its law. The two points do not say which of two such States prevails when their rules conflict.
en.impact: Two courts can each apply their own State's compulsory insurance law to the same policy.
en.correction: The Commission's work on the application of the Regulation could say which State prevails.
